EngagementSignalMetric.name: EngagementSignalMetric
EngagementSignalMetric.description: Represents a measurable quantity that’s derived from an engagement signal, such as the sum of revenue or a count of clicks. Use this object to track user engagement for A/B tests, machine learning model training, and attribution configurations. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

AggregateFunction.description: Defines the type of calculation used on the metric field.

EngagementSignalId.description: Required. Represents the ID of the engagement signal that’s associated with the metric.

IsRemote.description: Indicates if the engagement signal metric object is owned by a different org in Data 360.

LastReferencedDate.description: Timestamp that indicates the last time the engagement signal metric was referenced by the current user.

LastViewedDate.description: Timestamp that indicates the last time the current user viewed the engagement signal metric record.

Name.description: Required. Text label that identifies the engagement signal metric.
